items.name: Lodestar
items.desc:
Five magnetized lengths that answer to him and nobody else. Nothing sentimental about it. Just a tool that comes back when he needs it.

Can be locked rigid, folded flat, or have its pull rerouted at will. Recalls to his hand from anywhere in sight as a single action.

actions.name: Recall
actions.notes: Summon the staff to your hand from anywhere within sight, as an action.
